title: "Bhula Sake Gi Na Dunya Teri Wafa Ghazi Hasan Sadiq"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Mushtaq"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false

1
Bhula Sake Gi Na Dunya Teri Wafa Ghazi Hasan Sadiq.
Hain Dono Bazu Tere Deen Ki Baqa Ghazi.
Chahar Simt Thi Yalgar Ahl-e-Batil Ki.
Alam Na Jhukney Diya Our Na Khud Jhuka Ghazi.

2
Nibhai Iss Tarha Shabeer Se Wafa Tu Ne.
Wafa Ko Kehna Para Tu Hai Bawafa Ghazi.
Tareekh Aaj Bhi Jhutla Issay Nahi Sakti.
Tere Hi Khon Ka Sadqa Hai Lailaha Ghazi.

3
Kaha Sakina Ne Baba Na Pani Mangoon Gi.
Bola Lo Khaimon Mein Jaldi Mera Chacha Ghazi.
Pukarey Jaein Gay Mushtaq Hashar Mein Paihum.
Dar-e-Batool Ke Sag Hain Tere Gada Ghazi.

    assert len(stanzas) == 3
    for stanza, digit in zip(stanzas, digits):
        label, *verses = [line.strip() for line in stanza.splitlines()]
        assert label == digit and len(verses) == 4 and all(verses)
print('Both editions contain three matching four-verse stanzas.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Urdu script and verified that both editions follow the same three four-verse stanzas. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, set the text direction to RTL, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Bola lo” as **بلا لو**, consistent with the request to call her uncle into the tents.
